name: So Long, Summer Days
source: "So Long, Summer Days" follows Enrique "Pan" Domingo on his quest to actually do something.Through a potent mixture of laziness and a somewhat inspiring determination, he's managed to live a jobless life in a nameless suburb since before he even got married. It's worn on his wife and he's not really sure if he's tired of it either. There's something a little sad about this life. Between scrounging for cigarettes and nothing at all, you can't help but wonder if there's anything else. But these dog day's will end. Thousands of Jellyfish lay dead on the shore. He knows he can't linger but he has to watch. Summer can't last forever.
